visual_requirements.description: bearded male sky god, one head two arms two legs and two feather wings, fully opaque aged-bronze robe and cuirass, plain sword
Physical sword combat against Giants, no invented cosmic beams; night sky reflects his sky identity
dark sky above a rocky combat ledge, editorial staging of documented Gigantomachy

source_claims.quote: Uranus (also spelt Ouranos) is the personification of heaven and the sky in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Uranus atau Ouranos adalah personifikasi langit dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Uranus or Ouranos is the personification of the sky in Greek mythology.

source_claims.quote: He is, however, identified on the Gigantomachy frieze on the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, fighting against the Giants with a sword

statement.id: Uranus diidentifikasi pada relief Gigantomachy di Altar Pergamon, berjenggot dan bersayap, melawan para Raksasa dengan pedang.
statement.en: Uranus is identified on the Gigantomachy frieze of the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, fighting the Giants with a sword.

artistic_choices: Palette, camera, age details, opaque clothing embellishment and unspecific staging are editorial choices, not additional source facts.
Dominance through close framing and foreshortening unless source documents scale.
No outward power added beyond documented domain; weather, light and debris remain physically grounded.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: NO text, letters, pseudo-writing, glyphs, runes, logos, signatures or decorative script anywhere including clothing, weapons, architecture.
